import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the iris dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot to visualize relationships between features, colored by species
pairplot = sns.pairplot(data, hue='species', palette='Set2', diag_kind='kde', markers=['o', 's', 'D'])

# Add title and adjust layout
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Iris Species - Pairplot of Sepal and Petal Dimensions', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
